title: Subqueries and Documents
toolchain: duckdb (v1.5.6, ~/.local/bin/duckdb, the version of the lecture's demos): relational queries `duckdb -readonly ../source/movies.duckdb -c "<sql>"`, document queries `duckdb -readonly ../source/movies-json.duckdb -c "<sql>"` (paths from the project folder; for longer SQL, a heredoc `duckdb -readonly <db> <<'EOF' … EOF`). Never open the databases without -readonly. Run every query shown on screen, including the ones meant to fail, and quote results and error messages exactly as printed
